shortBio.en: Early Maiden vocal; street bark on Iron Maiden and Killers.
shortBio.zh: 早期 Maiden 主唱；Iron Maiden 与 Killers 上的街头吠叫。

body.en:
Born 1958. Fronts debut and Killers with street-metal bark before Dickinson’s operatic swap. Chapter remains the NWOBHM club-era citation.

Short tenure; high contrast value against Beast-era vocals.
body.zh:
1958 年生。以街头金属吠叫主唱首专与 Killers，先于 Dickinson 歌剧式替换。章节仍是 NWOBHM 俱乐部时期引用。

任期短；对 Beast 时期人声的高对比价值。
